title: What If the Sun Went Out Right Now?

scenes.text: What if the Sun switched off right now? You wouldn't know for eight minutes.
That's how long its light takes to reach us. Then: darkness, everywhere, at once.
Plants would stop making food within days. Within a week the average temperature would fall below freezing.
Within a year, about minus seventy. The ocean surface would freeze solid, but the deep water would stay liquid for ages.
Life would hang on in one place: around volcanic vents on the sea floor, warmed by the planet itself.
And Earth would keep orbiting the dark Sun for another eight minutes before flying off in a straight line.

description:
